question: Does the query representation carry enough signal to decide when to leave R1 (reasoning), and for whom?

labels.which_alternative: argmax over stable m by (mean5 delta, consistency, slot order)
labels.note: Decomposed oracle equals the 81.00% hindsight oracle: the two-stage split is lossless.

representations_detail.R0_gte: frozen Original GTE-Qwen2-7B-instruct embedding (same features as A in E6)
representations_detail.R1_gte_struct: R0 + 15 deterministic structural features + 14 subject one-hot (control)
representations_detail.R2_qwen: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct final-layer hidden state, raw panel text, masked mean pool, no generation
representations_detail.R3_all: concatenation of R1 blocks and R2
representations_detail.structural: log stem/total chars, n options, digit & math-symbol counts+densities, $ count, code-hint count, newlines, option length mean/max, ends-?, Wh-start, stem words; frozen char sets in code

classifier.stage1: StandardScaler(dev) + L2 logistic C=1.0 lbfgs, threshold 0.5 frozen
classifier.stage2: same estimator on dev stable-switch queries only; argmax over available classes
classifier.no_pca: PCA not used; identical pipeline across representations
classifier.fit: scaler/logistic/threshold fitted or fixed on development fold only
classifier.sensitivity: threshold=development switch base rate reported as non-decisional sensitivity

success: EQ>73.50% (E6 A_QueryOnly) AND paired query bootstrap CI95 lower>0 vs A; sole criterion, AUC/F1 are diagnostics only

bootstrap.bonferroni: 98.75% intervals for 4 representations vs A reported as context

branches.on_pass: integrate the winning representation back into the MA router
branches.on_fail: stop pure query-only static routing; move to query -> cheap model probe/partial response -> routing

constraints: No new model answers except local Qwen forward passes
